script:
set -eu
echo NODE_WRITE_STATE
printf 'pwd=%s\n' "$PWD"
printf 'env_count=%s\n' "$(env | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
echo ENV_SELECTED_BEGIN
env | sort | grep -E '^(FABRO|GITHUB|CI|HOME|PWD|USER|RUN|WORKFLOW|SANDBOX|PR|BASE|HEAD|BRANCH|GIT)=' || true
echo ENV_SELECTED_END
printf 'alpha\n' > /tmp/fabro-debug-state.txt
mkdir -p .fabro/tmp
printf 'beta\n' > .fabro/tmp/fabro-debug-state.txt
echo context_marker_from_write_state=visible_in_command_output
